messages:
jake_sales: quick handoff for Trident Data — sale closed last week. primary contacts: @ctucker (ops), @nlee (platform eng). they signed up for Dedicated for an initial pilot, asked for private eval and SSO. renewal window in 10 months but flagged as high churn risk due to strict latency needs and limited budget.

maria_cs: thanks! can you paste the contract notes and the list of required integrations? any blockers we should know about? :eyes:

jake_sales: contract: 12mo, committed 2x GPUs, option to expand. notes: legal needs SOC2 attestation, procurement wants KMS/HSM details, ops team wants dedicated VPC peering. budget constraint: requested discounted tier; finance approved trial discount but warned about renewal pushback.

maria_cs: got it. I'll schedule an enablement workshop and own onboarding. who will own SSO setup and private eval infra?

jake_sales: @alisha_pm is PM on the deal and can coordinate infra funnel. Sam from support will own the SSO connector and initial health checks.

sam_support: I can take SSO + initial infra checklist. need an account with admin keys and the customer's IdP metadata. also will open a runbook ticket for the private eval flow. can someone share the provisioning script?

alisha_pm: sharing infra checklist now — https://redwood.example.com/internal/trident-infra-checklist (internal). main items: VPC peering, route tables, KMS key policy, firewall rules for GPU pool, and pre-wired metrics exports to our Console. plan to do a 60-min enablement on Tue 03/23.

maria_cs: perfect. I'll invite ops and engineering stakeholders. prep items for customer: SSO metadata, CIDR blocks for peering, expected throughput (token/sec), sample prompt mix. also need to capture initial eval success criteria for renewal (SLOs: p95 latency <120ms, error rate <0.5%).

jake_sales: customer success criteria agreed in convo: 1) <120ms p95 on curated prompt set, 2) cost-per-1000 tokens within agreed TCO, 3) secure key handling via KMS. finance wants a checkpoint at month 2 to revisit discount.

sam_support: opening support ticket and runbook: #SUP-4571. attaching provisioning snippet:
```
# run to provision test env
redwoodctl provision --customer trident --mode private-eval --gpus 2 --region us-west-2
```
Please put admin creds in 1Password, tag team:trident.

maria_cs: action items: 
- maria_cs: schedule enablement (invite + agenda) — due EOD today
- sam_support: start runbook + request IdP metadata — due tomorrow
- alisha_pm: confirm VPC peering window & share firewall rules — due Fri
- jake_sales: upload signed contract and procurement contact info to the doc — due today

alisha_pm: noted. I'll also add a note to the rollout plan to include a smoke test for prefix caching and batching.

jake_sales: FYI there was a comment from procurement about billing cadence — they prefer quarterly invoicing. may impact finance approval; flagging as renewal risk.

maria_cs: will set renewal_risk tag on the account and add to next weekly CS sync. capturing feedback loop: we'll run a short post-enable survey and gate expansion on meeting their SLOs.

deploy-bot: Support ticket SUP-4571 created and assigned to sam_support. Deployment playbook copied to /playbooks/trident-priv-eval.

sam_support: thumbs up. I'll post status updates in this thread and create a dedicated run channel once the peering window is set.

maria_cs: thanks team — closing loop here. next sync in this thread after enablement prep. :white_check_mark:
